best.text: The 'Big' cat is basically a 1.5 - 2 year old  baby cat, an experienced older cat  would definitely have adapted to the rescued kitten in a matter of days. Just look at the relaxed old cat who pops in screen occasionally, totally calm. I had a lot of cats since i was a kid and the way they socialize is just a joy to watch.
I love how brave the baby is, actively pursuing the bigger cat even as the older one sometimes swats at him.
I like how the orange cat didn't care one bit 😅
Strange the orange/white cat doesn't get involved, but i love how these 2 tabbys play together, and the little one is so brave

Introducing a kitten will bring some much needed life to an older cat. One tip I'd offer is place some high up spaces that the older cat can retreat to when it needs a break. Kittens are relentless and will constantly hassle older cats for play. They definitely need those safe spaces.
Look at him all puffed up trying to look big. Gotta admire the Moxie!😊. He held his ground even when he was scared. Tough little man.

Watching this little soul grow from day 1 to 180 is just incredible. It’s amazing how much love and patience can change a kitten's life. The way the big cats eventually accepted him just melts my heart! ❤
This little kitten has a lot of spunk. She is daring and brings out the kitten qualities in the older cat. This is fun to watch. It is great to see how they have become good friends.
Super super fun and cute video thank you!
I love how cats can be so scared but driven by their natural curiosity so much that they push through.
